verdict.rationale: A government tax-filing portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows an AI assistant or agent inside Webfile, eSystems or the Comptroller site. The documented surfaces are manual filing tools, phone filing, help videos and read-only open-data datasets, none of which let a user delegate tasks to an AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
